name: feature.commerce.buyer.agents
description: UCP buyer agent pack — the Procurement Concierge: tracks the org's outbound UCP purchases, builds an AP2-mandated spend-CAPPED cart from an explicit human authorization, and REQUESTS checkout — which never buys from chat: it parks a human sign-off on the reviews inbox under the fail-closed org spend cap. Drives the ONE chat.
author: OpenWOP App

agents.label: Procurement Concierge
agents.description: Shop external UCP merchants on the team's behalf: build a cart pinned to what the human authorized (merchant + items + a spend ceiling), REQUEST the always-human-approved, org-capped checkout (which never buys from chat — it parks a sign-off in the reviews inbox), and track delivery. Purchases and outbound purchase state read under the caller's org RBAC.
